title: The salt road, a Dres raid party on it, and a created character walking down it. The fixture for RI-CHR02 method 8 — the AR-3 assertion.
note: The character block is overwritten by the scenario's --state race=<r> argument. Every race gets the SAME encounter id, the SAME statblocks and the SAME movesets; only whether, when and how it opens differs. ROUND 2 FIX: the fixture used to sit at the province origin, which is 250 m out in the Topal — the player was walking in standing water and RI-WLD10's band retraction held them to ~1.47 m/s, so 480 frames of forward input closed only 11.8 m of a 30 m gap and the Khajiit 12 m band was never entered. The W1-07 verdict measured that as 'closest approach 18.198 m in all three runs, identically'. The road is now on dry salt-hills ground at (1544, 607), which is the region this encounter declares, and the same input closes the gap.
